title: Tidal bitmap
description: Two saturated inks form a pixel field that bends around the pointer and switches into a fractured signal.
useCase: Interactive binary texture for an expressive visual surface.
interaction: Move the pointer or arrow keys; change the field mode.
reducedMotion: The field freezes; pointer and mode controls update a single static frame.
limitations: Canvas 2D ordered dithering, not WebGL or a physical wave simulation.
look: Cobalt-blue field of chunky red pixels forming dithered interference blobs in a diagonal lattice, above a blue footer with white wordmark and monospace controls.
motion: Two sine waves drift through a 4×4 Bayer-dithered blue field whose red ink swells around the pointer; a mode toggle switches to blocky cells split at the pointer's height.
adapt: `draw` computes each pixel's `field` (two sine terms minus `dist * 2.2` for pointer falloff) and compares it to the 4×4 Bayer `threshold`; the canvas renders at a third of CSS size, capped at 180×120. Swap the RGB values for your two inks.
